articles.title: Pope Leo slept well after cancer surgery, but recovery could take ‘longer than expected’ - NBC News
articles.description: Peru’s president said the 71-year-old American pontiff’s planned visit might be in jeopardy as he recovers from surgery to remove part of his right lung.
